QUOTE: The user taps the failed post, which opens a bottom sheet (`app/components/post_list/post/body/failed/index.tsx`). "Try Again" calls `retryFailedPost(serverUrl, post)`. "Delete Message" removes the post.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that retry happens via the user choosing "Try Again" on the failed post, which calls `retryFailedPost`, and that nothing retries automatically.
